summary: Defines an extension to SMTP that lets a message carry a priority label so mail servers along its path can handle it preferentially. It is a standards-track specification, described as giving messages transfer priorities, and is aimed at environments where some mail must move ahead of other mail.

eli5.summary: Like a line at the airport where some people get a fast lane, this lets important emails carry a tag that says please let me through first.

questions: how to set email priority in smtp
